setName: Mattel Action Figure promotional cards: Series 3

Normal Parallel Rare.name: Ancient Gear Golem
Normal Parallel Rare.desc: Cannot be Special Summoned. If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

Normal Parallel Rare.name: Chthonian Soldier
Normal Parallel Rare.desc: When this card is destroyed by an opponent's attacking monster and sent to the Graveyard, the Battle Damage you took from this battle is also inflicted to your opponent.

Normal Parallel Rare.name: Cyber Dragon
Normal Parallel Rare.desc: If only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

Normal Parallel Rare.name: Elemental HERO Avian
Normal Parallel Rare.desc: A winged Elemental HERO who wheels through the sky and manipulates the wind. His signature move, Featherbreak, gives villainy a blow from sky-high.

Normal Parallel Rare.name: Elemental HERO Bladedge
Normal Parallel Rare.desc: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

Normal Parallel Rare.name: Elemental HERO Bubbleman
Normal Parallel Rare.desc: If this is the only card in your hand, you can Special Summon it (from your hand). When this card is Summoned: You can draw 2 cards. You must control no other cards and have no cards in your hand to activate and to resolve this effect.

Normal Parallel Rare.name: Elemental HERO Burstinatrix
Normal Parallel Rare.desc: A flame manipulator who was the first Elemental HERO woman. Her Burstfire burns away villainy.

Normal Parallel Rare.name: Elemental HERO Clayman
Normal Parallel Rare.desc: An Elemental HERO with a clay body built-to-last. He'll preserve his Elemental HERO colleagues at any cost.

Normal Parallel Rare.name: Elemental HERO Flame Wingman
Normal Parallel Rare.desc:
"Elemental HERO Avian" + "Elemental HERO Burstinatrix"
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the destroyed monster in the Graveyard.

Normal Parallel Rare.name: Elemental HERO Sparkman
Normal Parallel Rare.desc: ''An Elemental HERO and a warrior of light who proficiently wields many kinds of armaments. His Static Shockwave cuts off the path of villainy.''

Normal Parallel Rare.name: Winged Kuriboh LV10
Normal Parallel Rare.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Transcendent Wings". During your opponent's Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this face-up card; destroy as many Attack Position monsters your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the combined original ATK of those destroyed monster(s).
